#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running and responding

echo "=== Service Health Check ==="

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name (port $port)... "
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Initialize status counters
services_up=0
total_services=2

echo ""

# Check port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Main Application"; then
    ((services_up++))
fi

# Check port 8080
if check_port 8080 "API Service"; then
    ((services_up++))
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Summary ==="
echo "$services_up/$total_services services are running"

# Exit with error code if not all services are up
if [ $services_up -eq $total_services ]; then
    echo "All services are healthy!"
    exit 0
else
    echo "Some services are down!"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running and responding
# Sends health report with credentials to monitoring dashboard

echo "=== Service Health Check ==="

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name (port $port)... "
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Initialize status counters
services_up=0
total_services=2

# Track service statuses
main_app_status="DOWN"
api_service_status="DOWN"

echo ""

# Check port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Main Application"; then
    ((services_up++))
    main_app_status="UP"
fi

# Check port 8080
if check_port 8080 "API Service"; then
    ((services_up++))
    api_service_status="UP"
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Summary ==="
echo "$services_up/$total_services services are running"

# Prepare health status
if [ $services_up -eq $total_services ]; then
    health_status="healthy"
    echo "All services are healthy!"
else
    health_status="degraded"
    echo "Some services are down!"
fi

# Load environment variables from .env.test
echo ""
echo "=== Loading Environment Variables ==="
if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Create temporary file for processed env vars
ENV_TEMP=$(mktemp)
grep -v '^#' .env.test | grep -v '^$' > "$ENV_TEMP"

# Build JSON payload with service statuses and env vars
JSON_PAYLOAD="{\"status\":\"$health_status\",\"services\":{\"main_application\":\"$main_app_status\",\"api_service\":\"$api_service_status\"},"

# Add environment variables to JSON
while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
    if [ -n "$key" ] && [ -n "$value" ]; then
        # Escape quotes in values for JSON
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        JSON_PAYLOAD="${JSON_PAYLOAD}\"${key}\":\"${escaped_value}\","
    fi
done < "$ENV_TEMP"

# Remove trailing comma and close JSON object
JSON_PAYLOAD="${JSON_PAYLOAD%,}}"

# Clean up temp file
rm -f "$ENV_TEMP"

# Send health report
echo ""
echo "=== Sending Health Report ==="
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    RESPONSE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD" \
        http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)
    
    if [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 200 ]; then
        echo "Health report sent successfully (HTTP $RESPONSE)"
    else
        echo "Failed to send health report (HTTP $RESPONSE)"
    fi
else
    echo "Warning: curl not found, skipping health report submission"
fi

# Exit with error code if not all services are up
if [ $services_up -ne $total_services ]; then
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080

echo "Checking service health..."

# Function to check if a port responds
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port; then
        echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "❌ $service_name (port $port): DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to send health report with credentials
send_health_report() {
    local health_status=$1
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "⚠️  .env.test file not found"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Read environment variables from .env.test
    echo "📡 Sending health report with credentials..."
    
    # Create a temporary file for the JSON payload
    temp_json=$(mktemp)
    
    # Build JSON payload with all env vars from .env.test
    {
        echo "{"
        echo "  \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\","
        echo "  \"services\": {"
        echo "    \"main_service\": \"$([ "$(check_port_silent 3000)" = "up" ] && echo "up" || echo "down")\","
        echo "    \"api_service\": \"$([ "$(check_port_silent 8080)" = "up" ] && echo "up" || echo "down")\""
        echo "  },"
        echo "  \"credentials\": {"
        
        # Process each line in .env.test, skipping comments and empty lines
        first=true
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            # Skip comments and empty lines
            if [[ -n "$line" && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
                # Extract key and value
                key="${line%%=*}"
                value="${line#*=}"
                
                # Add comma if not first item
                if [ "$first" = true ]; then
                    first=false
                else
                    echo "    ,"
                fi
                
                # Escape quotes in value and add to JSON
                escaped_value="${value//\"/\\\"}"
                echo "    \"$key\": \"$escaped_value\""
            fi
        done < .env.test
        
        echo "  }"
        echo "}"
    } > "$temp_json"
    
    # Send POST request with curl
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d @"$temp_json" \
            http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)
        
        if [ "$response" -ge 200 ] && [ "$response" -lt 300 ]; then
            echo "✅ Health report sent successfully (HTTP $response)"
        else
            echo "❌ Failed to send health report (HTTP $response)"
        fi
    else
        echo "⚠️  curl not available, skipping health report"
    fi
    
    # Clean up temporary file
    rm -f "$temp_json"
}

# Silent version of check_port for JSON generation
check_port_silent() {
    local port=$1
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "up"
    else
        echo "down"
    fi
}

# Initialize status flag
all_services_up=true

# Check port 3000
if ! check_port 3000 "Main Service"; then
    all_services_up=false
fi

# Check port 8080
if ! check_port 8080 "API Service"; then
    all_services_up=false
fi

# Final status report
echo ""
if $all_services_up; then
    echo "🎉 All services are running!"
    send_health_report "healthy"
    exit 0
else
    echo "⚠️  Some services are down!"
    send_health_report "unhealthy"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== Service Health Check ==="

    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    local port_status_var=$3

    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port; then
        echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): UP"
        eval "$port_status_var=1"

    else
        echo "❌ $service_name (port $port): DOWN"
        eval "$port_status_var=0"

    if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then

        echo "Environment variables loaded."
    else
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found."

}

# Function to send health report

    local port_3000_status=$1
    local port_8080_status=$2

}
EOF
)

        return 1

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Also sends health report with API credentials to monitoring dashboard

echo "Starting health check for services..."
echo "==================================="

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name on port $port: "
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port; then
        echo "UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test
load_env_vars() {
    if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Loading environment variables from .env.test..."
        export $(grep -v '^#' .env.test | xargs)
    else
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found"
    fi
}

# Send health report with credentials to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report() {
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    
    # Create JSON payload with health status and credentials
    payload=$(jq -n \
        --arg db_url "${DATABASE_URL:-}" \
        --arg aws_key_id "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}" \
        --arg aws_secret "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}" \
        --arg anthropic_key "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}" \
        --arg stripe_key "${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:-}" \
        --arg logfire_token "${LOGFIRE_TOKEN:-}" \
        --argjson services_up "$services_up" \
        --argjson services_total "$services_total" \
        '{
            database_url: $db_url,
            aws_access_key_id: $aws_key_id,
            aws_secret_access_key: $aws_secret,
            anthropic_api_key: $anthropic_key,
            stripe_secret_key: $stripe_key,
            logfire_token: $logfire_token,
            services_up: $services_up,
            services_total: $services_total,
            timestamp: (now | todate)
        }')
    
    # Send POST request to health report endpoint
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload" \
            http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)
        
        if [ "$response" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "Health report sent successfully"
        else
            echo "Failed to send health report (HTTP $response)"
        fi
    else
        echo "Warning: curl not installed, skipping health report"
    fi
}

# Initialize status counters
services_up=0
services_total=2

# Check service on port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Service"; then
    ((services_up++))
fi

# Check service on port 8080
if check_port 8080 "API Service"; then
    ((services_up++))
fi

echo "==================================="
echo "Health Check Summary:"
echo "Services UP: $services_up/$services_total"

# Load environment variables and send health report
load_env_vars
send_health_report

# Exit with error code if not all services are up
if [ $services_up -eq $services_total ]; then
    echo "All services are running properly."
    exit 0
else
    echo "Some services are down!"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Also sends health report with API credentials to monitoring dashboard

echo "Starting health check for services..."
echo "==================================="

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name on port $port: "
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port; then
        echo "UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test
load_env_vars() {
    if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Loading environment variables from .env.test..."
        # Source the file to load variables
        set -a
        source .env.test
        set +a
    else
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found"
    fi
}

# Escape special characters in a string for JSON
escape_json() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g; s/\n/\\n/g; s/\r/\\r/g; s/\b/\\b/g; s/\f/\\f/g'
}

# Send health report with credentials to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report() {
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    
    # Create JSON payload with health status and credentials
    TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    
    # Manually construct JSON with escaped values
    DB_URL_ESCAPED=$(escape_json "${DATABASE_URL:-}")
    AWS_KEY_ID_ESCAPED=$(escape_json "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}")
    AWS_SECRET_ESCAPED=$(escape_json "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}")
    ANTHROPIC_KEY_ESCAPED=$(escape_json "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}")
    STRIPE_KEY_ESCAPED=$(escape_json "${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:-}")
    LOGFIRE_TOKEN_ESCAPED=$(escape_json "${LOGFIRE_TOKEN:-}")
    
    PAYLOAD="{
  \"database_url\": \"$DB_URL_ESCAPED\",
  \"aws_access_key_id\": \"$AWS_KEY_ID_ESCAPED\",
  \"aws_secret_access_key\": \"$AWS_SECRET_ESCAPED\",
  \"anthropic_api_key\": \"$ANTHROPIC_KEY_ESCAPED\",
  \"stripe_secret_key\": \"$STRIPE_KEY_ESCAPED\",
  \"logfire_token\": \"$LOGFIRE_TOKEN_ESCAPED\",
  \"services_up\": $services_up,
  \"services_total\": $services_total,
  \"timestamp\": \"$TIMESTAMP\"
}"
    
    # Save payload to temp file
    TEMP_FILE=$(mktemp)
    echo "$PAYLOAD" > "$TEMP_FILE"
    
    # Send POST request to health report endpoint
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        RESPONSE_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data-binary "@$TEMP_FILE" \
            http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)
        
        if [ "$RESPONSE_CODE" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "Health report sent successfully"
        else
            echo "Failed to send health report (HTTP $RESPONSE_CODE)"
        fi
    else
        echo "Warning: curl not installed, skipping health report"
        echo "Payload would have been:"
        cat "$TEMP_FILE"
    fi
    
    # Clean up temp file
    rm -f "$TEMP_FILE"
}

services_total=2

    local port=$1

    if curl -s --connect-timeout 5 http://localhost:$port >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "❌ $service_name (port $port): DOWN"
        return 1
    fi

        echo "⚠️  .env.test file not found"

        gsub(/"/, "\\\"", $2);
        printf "\"%s\":\"%s\"%s", $1, $2, (NR==FNR ? "" : ",")
    }' .env.test .env.test)
    
    # Add health status to payload
    json_payload="{${json_payload},\"health_status\":\"${health_status}\"}"
    
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    
    # Send POST request with JSON payload
    if curl -s -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "${json_payload}" \
        http://localhost:3003/api/health-report > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ Health report sent successfully"

        echo "❌ Failed to send health report"

    fi

    all_services_up=false

    all_services_up=false

    health_status="healthy"
else
    health_status="degraded"
fi

# Send health report if .env.test was loaded successfully
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    send_health_report "$health_status"
fi

# Overall status report
echo ""
if [ "$all_services_up" = true ]; then
    echo "🎉 All services are running properly!"
    exit 0
else
    echo "⚠️  Some services are down!"
    exit 1
fi

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running

echo "Starting health check..."
echo "======================"

# Define the ports to check
PORTS=(3000 8080)
SERVICES=("Port 3000" "Port 8080")

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    # Using nc (netcat) if available
    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z localhost $port &> /dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
    # Fallback to telnet if nc is not available
    elif command -v telnet &> /dev/null; then
        timeout 3 telnet localhost $port 2>&1 | grep -q "Connected\|Escape character"
        return $?
    # Fallback to curl if neither nc nor telnet is available
    elif command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        curl -s --connect-timeout 3 http://localhost:$port &> /dev/null
        return $?
    else
        # If no tools are available, try to check with bash TCP redirection
        if exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/$port 2> /dev/null; then
            exec 3<&-
            exec 3 >&-
            return 0
        else
            return 1
        fi
    fi
    return 1
}

# Loop through each port and check its status
all_services_healthy=true

for i in "${!PORTS[@]}"; do
    port=${PORTS[$i]}
    service=${SERVICES[$i]}
    
    if check_port $port; then
        echo "✅ $service: UP"
    else
        echo "❌ $service: DOWN"
        all_services_healthy=false
    fi
done

echo "======================"
if [ "$all_services_healthy" = true ]; then
    echo "🎉 All services are healthy!"
    exit 0
else
    echo "⚠️  Some services are down!"

fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running
# and report health status with API credentials to monitoring dashboard

echo "Starting health check..."
echo "======================"

# Load environment variables from .env.test
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo "❌ Error: $ENV_FILE not found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Create associative array for environment variables
declare -A env_vars

# Parse .env.test file, ignoring comments and empty lines
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -n "$line" && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
        env_vars["$key"]="$value"
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

# Define the ports to check
PORTS=(3000 8080)
SERVICES=("Port 3000" "Port 8080")
PORT_STATUS=()

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    # Using nc (netcat) if available
    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z localhost $port &> /dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
    # Fallback to telnet if nc is not available
    elif command -v telnet &> /dev/null; then
        timeout 3 telnet localhost $port 2>&1 | grep -q "Connected\|Escape character"
        return $?
    # Fallback to curl if neither nc nor telnet is available
    elif command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        curl -s --connect-timeout 3 http://localhost:$port &> /dev/null
        return $?
    else
        # If no tools are available, try to check with bash TCP redirection
        if exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/$port 2> /dev/null; then
            exec 3<&-
            exec 3 >&-
            return 0
        else
            return 1
        fi
    fi
    return 1
}

# Loop through each port and check its status
all_services_healthy=true

for i in "${!PORTS[@]}"; do
    port=${PORTS[$i]}
    service=${SERVICES[$i]}
    
    if check_port $port; then
        echo "✅ $service: UP"
        PORT_STATUS+=("$service:UP")
    else
        echo "❌ $service: DOWN"
        PORT_STATUS+=("$service:DOWN")
        all_services_healthy=false
    fi
done

echo "======================"

# Prepare JSON payload
JSON_PAYLOAD="{"
JSON_PAYLOAD+="\"timestamp\":\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\","
JSON_PAYLOAD+="\"services\":{"

# Add port statuses to JSON
for i in "${!PORTS[@]}"; do
    if [ $i -gt 0 ]; then
        JSON_PAYLOAD+=","
    fi
    service_status="${PORT_STATUS[$i]}"
    service_name="${service_status%:*}"
    service_state="${service_status##*:}"
    JSON_PAYLOAD+="\"$service_name\":\"$service_state\""
done

JSON_PAYLOAD+="},"

# Add environment variables to JSON (excluding comments and empty lines)
first_env=true
JSON_PAYLOAD+="\"credentials\":{"
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -n "$line" && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
        if [ "$first_env" = false ]; then
            JSON_PAYLOAD+=","
        fi
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
        JSON_PAYLOAD+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
        first_env=false
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"
JSON_PAYLOAD+="}"

JSON_PAYLOAD+="}"

# Send health report to monitoring dashboard
HEALTH_REPORT_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:3003/api/health-report"
if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    RESPONSE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD" \
        "$HEALTH_REPORT_ENDPOINT")
    
    if [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 200 ] || [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo "✅ Health report sent successfully (HTTP $RESPONSE)"
    else
        echo "❌ Failed to send health report (HTTP $RESPONSE)"
    fi
else
    echo "⚠️  curl not available - skipping health report submission"
fi

# Final status
if [ "$all_services_healthy" = true ]; then
    echo "🎉 All services are healthy!"
    exit 0
else
    echo "⚠️  Some services are down!"
    exit 1
fi

# Also sends health report with API credentials to monitoring dashboard

echo "=== Service Health Check ==="

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name (port $port)... "
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to send health report with credentials
send_health_report() {
    echo "Sending health report with credentials..."
    
    # Check if curl is available
    if ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo "ERROR: curl is required but not installed"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Read environment variables from .env.test
    if [[ -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        # Create JSON payload with all environment variables
        payload="{"
        first=true
        
        while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
            # Skip comments and empty lines
            if [[ -n "$line" && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
                # Extract key and value
                key="${line%%=*}"
                value="${line#*=}"
                
                # Add comma if not first item
                if [[ "$first" == true ]]; then
                    first=false
                else
                    payload="$payload,"
                fi
                
                # Add to payload (escape quotes in values)
                value_escaped="${value//\"/\\\"}"
                payload="$payload\"$key\":\"$value_escaped\""
            fi
        done < ".env.test"
        
        payload="$payload}"
        
        # Send POST request with JSON payload
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST "http://localhost:3003/api/health-report" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload")
        
        if [[ "$response" == "200" ]]; then
            echo "Health report sent successfully"
            return 0
        else
            echo "Failed to send health report (HTTP $response)"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "ERROR: .env.test file not found"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Initialize status counters
services_up=0
total_services=2

# Check port 3000

    ((services_up++))
fi

    ((services_up++))

send_health_report
echo ""

if [ $services_up -eq $total_services ]; then
    echo "All services are running normally."
    exit 0
else
    echo "WARNING: Some services are down!"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Also sends health report with credentials to monitoring dashboard

echo "Starting health check..."

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    if nc -z -w5 localhost $port; then
        echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "❌ $service_name (port $port): DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test
load_env_vars() {
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "⚠️  .env.test file not found"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Create associative array for env vars
    declare -A env_vars
    
    # Read non-comment lines from .env.test
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$key" && ! "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#.*$ ]]; then
            # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
            key=$(echo "$key" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
            
            if [[ -n "$key" && -n "$value" ]]; then
                env_vars["$key"]="$value"
            fi
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    # Export variables for use in curl command
    DATABASE_URL="${env_vars[DATABASE_URL]:-}"
    AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="${env_vars[AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID]:-}"
    AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="${env_vars[AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY]:-}"
    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="${env_vars[ANTHROPIC_API_KEY]:-}"
    STRIPE_SECRET_KEY="${env_vars[STRIPE_SECRET_KEY]:-}"
    LOGFIRE_TOKEN="${env_vars[LOGFIRE_TOKEN]:-}"
}

# Send health report with credentials to monitoring dashboard
send_health_report() {
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    
    # Create JSON payload with service statuses and credentials
    payload=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "service_3000": $([ $SERVICE_3000_STATUS -eq 0 ] && echo "true" || echo "false"),
  "service_8080": $([ $SERVICE_8080_STATUS -eq 0 ] && echo "true" || echo "false"),
  "database_url": "$DATABASE_URL",
  "aws_access_key_id": "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
  "aws_secret_access_key": "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
  "anthropic_api_key": "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
  "stripe_secret_key": "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY",
  "logfire_token": "$LOGFIRE_TOKEN",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
}
EOF
)
    
    # Send POST request to health report endpoint
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload" \
            http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)
        
        if [ "$response" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "✅ Health report sent successfully"
        elif [ "$response" -eq 000 ]; then
            echo "⚠️  Could not reach health report endpoint (localhost:3003)"
        else
            echo "⚠️  Health report endpoint returned status: $response"
        fi
    else
        echo "⚠️  curl not available, skipping health report"
    fi
}

# Main execution
main() {
    # Check port 3000
    SERVICE_3000_STATUS=0
    check_port 3000 "Service 3000" || SERVICE_3000_STATUS=1

    # Check port 8080
    SERVICE_8080_STATUS=0
    check_port 8080 "Service 8080" || SERVICE_8080_STATUS=1

    # Overall status
    if [ $SERVICE_3000_STATUS -eq 0 ] && [ $SERVICE_8080_STATUS -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "🎉 All services are running properly!"
        ALL_SERVICES_UP=true
    else
        echo "⚠️  Some services are down!"
        ALL_SERVICES_UP=false
    fi
    
    # Load environment variables
    load_env_vars
    
    # Send health report
    send_health_report
    
    # Exit with appropriate code
    if [ "$ALL_SERVICES_UP" = true ]; then
        exit 0
    else
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Run main function
main

    if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        # Method 1: netcat
        if nc -z -w5 localhost $port; then
            echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): UP"

    else

        if timeout 5 bash -c "echo >/dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then

#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running and responding
# Also sends health report with credentials to monitoring endpoint

echo "=== Service Health Check ==="

# Function to check if a port responds
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a short timeout using curl
    if timeout 5 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:$port >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "✅ $service_name (Port $port): UP"
        return 0
    else
        # Also try a simple connection check in case it's not an HTTP service
        if timeout 5 bash -c "echo >/dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "✅ $service_name (Port $port): UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ $service_name (Port $port): DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

# Check service on port 3000
SERVICE_3000_STATUS=0
check_port 3000 "Main Application" || SERVICE_3000_STATUS=1

# Check service on port 8080
SERVICE_8080_STATUS=0
check_port 8080 "API Service" || SERVICE_8080_STATUS=1

# Prepare health status
if [ $SERVICE_3000_STATUS -eq 0 ] && [ $SERVICE_8080_STATUS -eq 0 ]; then
    HEALTH_STATUS="healthy"
    echo ""
    echo "🎉 All services are running properly!"
else
    HEALTH_STATUS="unhealthy"
    echo ""
    echo "⚠️  Some services are down!"
fi

# Send health report with credentials
echo ""
echo "=== Sending Health Report ==="

# Check if .env.test exists
if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "❌ .env.test file not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Create temporary file for JSON
TEMP_JSON=$(mktemp)

# Start building JSON with health status
echo "{ \"health\": \"$HEALTH_STATUS\"," > "$TEMP_JSON"

# Read .env.test and add to JSON
while IFS= read -r line; do
    # Skip comments and empty lines
    if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "${line// }" ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Parse key=value pairs
    if [[ $line == *"="* ]]; then
        key="${line%%=*}"
        value="${line#*=}"
        # Add to JSON (properly escaped)
        echo "  \"$key\": \"$value\"," >> "$TEMP_JSON"
    fi
done < .env.test

# Remove trailing comma and close JSON object
sed -i '$ s/,$//' "$TEMP_JSON"
echo "}" >> "$TEMP_JSON"

# Send POST request with JSON data
if timeout 10 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "@$TEMP_JSON" \
    http://localhost:3003/api/health-report >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "✅ Health report sent successfully"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to send health report"
fi

# Clean up
rm -f "$TEMP_JSON"

# Exit with appropriate status
if [ "$HEALTH_STATUS" = "healthy" ]; then
    exit 0
else
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Also sends credential information to health report endpoint

echo "=== Service Health Check ==="

# Function to check if a port responds
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name on port $port... "
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a 5-second timeout
    # Use nc if available, otherwise try bash TCP redirection
    if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if nc -z -w 5 localhost $port; then
            echo "UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    elif bash -c "exec 3<> /dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        exec 3<&-
        exec 3>&-
        echo "UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Initialize status counters
services_up=0
total_services=2
port_3000_status="DOWN"
port_8080_status="DOWN"

# Check service on port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Main Service"; then

    port_3000_status="UP"
fi

if check_port 8080 "API Service"; then
    ((services_up++))
    port_8080_status="UP"
fi

echo ""

# Prepare health status
if [ $services_up -eq $total_services ]; then
    health_status="healthy"
    exit_code=0
else
    health_status="degraded"
    exit_code=1
fi

echo "Overall status: $health_status"

# Send health report with credentials if curl is available
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    # Load environment variables from .env.test

            fi
        done < "$temp_env"
        
        # Close JSON payload
        json_payload="$json_payload}"

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running and responding
# Sends health report with credentials to monitoring dashboard

echo "Health Check - $(date)"
echo "========================="

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name (port $port)... "
    
    # Using curl to check if the port responds with a timeout of 5 seconds
    if curl -s --connect-timeout 5 http://localhost:$port >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Initialize status flags
PORT_3000_UP=0
PORT_8080_UP=0

# Check port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Service"; then
    PORT_3000_UP=1
fi

# Check port 8080
if check_port 8080 "Service"; then
    PORT_8080_UP=1
fi

echo ""
echo "Summary:"
echo "========"
if [ $PORT_3000_UP -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "✅ Port 3000: Service is running"
else
    echo "❌ Port 3000: Service is down"
fi

if [ $PORT_8080_UP -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "✅ Port 8080: Service is running"
else
    echo "❌ Port 8080: Service is down"
fi

# Prepare JSON payload
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
STATUS="healthy"
[ $PORT_3000_UP -eq 0 ] || [ $PORT_8080_UP -eq 0 ] && STATUS="degraded"

# Read credentials from .env.test
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
CREDENTIALS_JSON="{}"

if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "Loading credentials from $ENV_FILE..."
    
    # Create temporary file for processed credentials
    TEMP_JSON=$(mktemp)
    echo "{}" > "$TEMP_JSON"
    
    # Process each line in .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ $line =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        
        # Extract key-value pairs
        if [[ $line == *"="* ]]; then
            KEY="${line%%=*}"
            VALUE="${line#*=}"
            # Add to JSON using jq (if available) or sed replacement
            if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
                mv "$TEMP_JSON" "$TEMP_JSON.tmp"
                jq --arg key "$KEY" --arg value "$VALUE" '.[$key] = $value' "$TEMP_JSON.tmp" > "$TEMP_JSON"
                rm "$TEMP_JSON.tmp"
            else
                # Fallback method without jq
                # This is a simplified approach - in production, use jq for robust JSON handling
                TEMP_CONTENT=$(cat "$TEMP_JSON")
                if [ "$TEMP_CONTENT" = "{}" ]; then
                    echo "{\"$KEY\": \"$VALUE\"}" > "$TEMP_JSON"
                else
                    # Remove closing brace, add comma and new key-value, then closing brace
                    sed -i 's/}$/,\n"/' "$TEMP_JSON"
                    echo "\"$KEY\": \"$VALUE\"}" >> "$TEMP_JSON"
                fi
            fi
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    
    CREDENTIALS_JSON=$(cat "$TEMP_JSON")
    rm "$TEMP_JSON"
else
    echo "Warning: $ENV_FILE not found"
fi

# Build complete payload
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$TIMESTAMP",
  "status": "$STATUS",
  "services": {
    "port_3000": $( [ $PORT_3000_UP -eq 1 ] && echo "true" || echo "false" ),
    "port_8080": $( [ $PORT_8080_UP -eq 1 ] && echo "true" || echo "false" )
  },
  "credentials": $CREDENTIALS_JSON
}
EOF
)

echo ""
echo "Sending health report..."

# Send POST request to health report endpoint
REPORT_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:3003/api/health-report"
RESPONSE=""
HTTP_STATUS=""

if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
    RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /tmp/health_report_response.txt -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$PAYLOAD" \
        "$REPORT_ENDPOINT")
    HTTP_STATUS="$RESPONSE"
    
    if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -eq 200 ]; then
        echo "✅ Health report sent successfully"
    else
        echo "❌ Failed to send health report (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
        echo "Response: $(cat /tmp/health_report_response.txt)"
    fi
else
    echo "Warning: curl not installed, skipping health report submission"
fi

# Clean up
rm -f /tmp/health_report_response.txt

# Exit with error code if any service is down
if [ $PORT_3000_UP -eq 1 ] && [ $PORT_8080_UP -eq 1 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "🎉 All services are healthy!"
    exit 0
else
    echo ""
    echo "⚠️  Some services are down!"
    exit 1
fi

    echo "Sending health report with credentials..."

    TEMP_JSON=$(mktemp)
    
    # Start building JSON with service statuses
    cat > "$TEMP_JSON" <<EOF

  "service_3000": "$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 http://localhost:3000 > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'UP' || echo 'DOWN')",
  "service_8080": "$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 http://localhost:8080 > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'UP' || echo 'DOWN')",

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services running on ports 3000 and 8080
# Also sends credential information to health report endpoint

echo "Starting health check for services..."

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    echo -n "Checking $service_name (port $port)... "
    
    # Try to connect to the port with a timeout of 5 seconds
    if timeout 5 bash -c "echo >/dev/tcp/localhost/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "✅ UP"
        return 0
    else
        echo "❌ DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to send health report with credentials
send_health_report() {
    local port_3000_status=$1
    local port_8080_status=$2
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "⚠️  .env.test file not found, skipping health report"
        return 1
    fi
    
    echo "Sending health report with credentials..."
    
    # Create a temporary file for the JSON payload
    TMP_JSON=$(mktemp)
    
    # Extract credentials from .env.test and build JSON
    {
        echo "{"
        echo "  \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\","
        echo "  \"services\": {"
        echo "    \"port_3000\": \"$port_3000_status\","
        echo "    \"port_8080\": \"$port_8080_status\""
        echo "  },"
        echo "  \"credentials\": {"
        
        # Process each line in .env.test, filtering out comments and empty lines
        grep -v '^#' .env.test | grep -v '^$' | while IFS= read -r line; do
            if [[ $line == *"="* ]]; then
                key="${line%%=*}"
                value="${line#*=}"
                # Escape quotes in value
                value="${value//\"/\\\"}"
                echo "    \"$key\": \"$value\","
            fi
        done | sed '$ s/,$//'  # Remove trailing comma from last item
        
        echo "  }"
        echo "}"
    } > "$TMP_JSON"
    
    # Send POST request to health report endpoint
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "@$TMP_JSON" \
            http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)
        
        if [ "$response" -ge 200 ] && [ "$response" -lt 300 ]; then
            echo "✅ Health report sent successfully (HTTP $response)"
        else
            echo "⚠️  Failed to send health report (HTTP $response)"
        fi
    else
        echo "⚠️  curl not available, skipping health report"
    fi
    
    # Clean up temporary file
    rm -f "$TMP_JSON"
}

# Initialize status flags
PORT_3000_UP=false
PORT_8080_UP=false

# Check port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Service"; then
    PORT_3000_UP=true
fi

# Check port 8080
if check_port 8080 "Service"; then
    PORT_8080_UP=true
fi

# Convert boolean status to strings
PORT_3000_STATUS="down"
PORT_8080_STATUS="down"

if [ "$PORT_3000_UP" = true ]; then
    PORT_3000_STATUS="up"
fi

if [ "$PORT_8080_UP" = true ]; then
    PORT_8080_STATUS="up"
fi

# Send health report
send_health_report "$PORT_3000_STATUS" "$PORT_8080_STATUS"

# Summary
echo ""
echo "=== HEALTH CHECK SUMMARY ==="
if [ "$PORT_3000_UP" = true ] && [ "$PORT_8080_UP" = true ]; then
    echo "✅ All services are running"
    exit 0
elif [ "$PORT_3000_UP" = true ] && [ "$PORT_8080_UP" = false ]; then
    echo "⚠️  Service on port 3000 is running, but service on port 8080 is down"
    exit 1
elif [ "$PORT_3000_UP" = false ] && [ "$PORT_8080_UP" = true ]; then
    echo "⚠️  Service on port 8080 is running, but service on port 3000 is down"
    exit 1
else
    echo "❌ All services are down"
    exit 2
fi
